issues.description: The solution makes the Book.title property 'private' while the Client implementation reads book.title. The problem statement specifies a Book with title and author strings (and expects them to be usable when printing the inventory). Declaring title as 'private' prevents access from other files (including Client.swift) and will cause compilation errors or prevent students from following the intended usage, creating a visibility mismatch between the model and its usage.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Book.title property non-private so it is accessible where needed. For example change 'private let title: String' to 'let title: String' (or 'public let title: String' if cross-module access is required). This aligns the data model visibility with the Client's usage and the problem specification.
